title: Majhul nisbat asoslari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida passiv shaklni (be + V3) turli zamonlarda to‘g‘ri tuzasiz, jarayonni kamida 5 ta passiv gap bilan tushuntirasiz va gazeta sarlavhalarini to‘liq gapga aylantira olasiz.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbat: xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda majburiyat, ruxsat va maslahat bildiruvchi modal fe’llarni o‘rgandik: must, should, can. Bugun yangi mavzu: majhul nisbat, inglizchasi passive voice. Dars oxirida biror mahsulot qanday tayyorlanishini tushuntira olasiz va gazeta sarlavhalarini tushunasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we are looking at the passive voice. It helps us talk about processes and news, when the action matters more than the person who did it.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun majhul nisbatni ko‘ramiz. U jarayonlar va yangiliklar haqida gapirishga yordam beradi, ya’ni ish-harakat uni qilgan odamdan muhimroq bo‘lganda.

scenes.title: Aktiv va passiv
board: Passive: Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.

examples.t: The bridge is built by workers.

scenes.say_native: Oddiy aktiv gapda ega ish-harakatni bajaradi: “Shakespeare wrote Hamlet”. Passivda esa to‘ldiruvchi gapning boshiga chiqadi: “Hamlet was written by Shakespeare”. Ma’no deyarli bir xil, lekin urg‘u o‘zgaradi: endi birinchi o‘rinda Hamlet turibdi, ya’ni gap asar haqida.
scenes.say: In an active sentence, the subject does the action. In a passive sentence, the thing that receives the action comes first. Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.
scenes.say_uz: Aktiv gapda ega ish-harakatni bajaradi. Passiv gapda ish-harakatni qabul qilgan narsa birinchi keladi. Hamlet Shekspir tomonidan yozilgan.

scenes.title: Shakli: be + V3
board: The room is cleaned every day.

examples.t: English is spoken all over the world.
These cars are made in Asaka.

scenes.say_native: Passivning formulasi bitta: “to be” fe’li kerakli zamonda, keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli, ya’ni past participle. Zamonni “be” ko‘rsatadi, ma’noni esa participle. “Is cleaned”, “are made”, “was built”: birinchisi hozirgi zamon, ikkinchisi ham hozirgi, uchinchisi o‘tgan zamon.
scenes.say: To make the passive, use the verb be in the right tense, and then the past participle. The room is cleaned every day. The rooms are cleaned every day.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul nisbatni yasash uchun kerakli zamondagi be fe’li va undan keyin past participle ishlating. Xona har kuni tozalanadi. Xonalar har kuni tozalanadi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha -il / -in qo‘shimchasi
board: EN: was written, was built, was opened
UZ: fe’lga qo‘shimcha  |  EN: be + V3
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida majhul nisbat bor: fe’lga -il yoki -in qo‘shamiz, masalan “qurildi”, “ochildi”, “yuborildi”. Inglizchada esa fe’lga qo‘shimcha qo‘shilmaydi, ikkita so‘z kerak: “was” va “built”. Ko‘p o‘zbek o‘quvchilari “was” ni tushirib qoldiradi va “The bridge built” deydi.
scenes.say: In Uzbek, you add a suffix to the verb. In English, you need two words: was, and the past participle. The shop was opened in 2015.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tilida fe’lga qo‘shimcha qo‘shiladi. Ingliz tilida ikki so‘z kerak: was va past participle. Do‘kon 2015-yilda ochilgan.

scenes.title: Hozirgi oddiy zamon passivi
board: Bread is baked in a tandoor.

examples.t: Plov is cooked in a kazan.

scenes.say_native: Hozirgi oddiy zamon passivi odatlar, umumiy haqiqatlar va jarayonlar uchun juda qulay. Uch misolni tinglang: paxta yetishtiriladi, palov qozonda pishiriladi, xatlar har ertalab tekshiriladi. Bunday gaplarni ko‘pincha “always”, “every day”, “usually” kabi so‘zlar bilan uchratasiz.
scenes.say: Cotton is grown in Uzbekistan. Plov is cooked in a kazan. Emails are checked every morning.
scenes.say_uz: Paxta O‘zbekistonda yetishtiriladi. Palov qozonda pishiriladi. Xatlar har ertalab tekshiriladi.

scenes.title: O‘tgan oddiy zamon passivi

examples.t: Two thieves were arrested last night.
examples.uz: Ikki o‘g‘ri kecha kechqurun hibsga olindi.

scenes.say_native: O‘tgan zamonda “was” yoki “were” ishlatamiz. Birlik ot bilan “was”, ko‘plik ot bilan “were”: “The museum was opened”, “Two thieves were arrested”. Odatda yonida “in 1990”, “last night”, “yesterday” kabi o‘tgan vaqt ko‘rsatkichi turadi. O‘zbekchada “ochilgan” yoki “hibsga olindi” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa shu ma’noni “was/were + V3” beradi.
scenes.say: For the past, use was or were. The museum was opened in 1990. Two thieves were arrested last night.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan zamon uchun was yoki were ishlating. Muzey 1990-yilda ochilgan. Ikki o‘g‘ri kecha kechqurun hibsga olindi.

scenes.title: Boshqa zamonlar va modal fe’llar
board: will be built / can be built / must be done

examples.t: A new school is being built.
The report must be finished today.

scenes.say_native: Passiv boshqa zamonlarda ham ishlaydi, faqat “be” shakli o‘zgaradi. Hozir davom etayotgan ish: “is being built”. Natijasi hozir ko‘rinib turgan ish: “has been repaired”. Kelasi zamon: “will be built”. Modal fe’llar bilan esa “be” o‘zgarmaydi: “must be finished”, “can be done”. Bu qoida bitta: “be” o‘zgaradi, participle o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say: A new school is being built. The road has been repaired. The report will be finished soon. It must be done today.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi maktab qurilmoqda. Yo‘l ta’mirlab bo‘ldi. Hisobot tez orada tugatiladi. Uni bugun bajarish kerak.

scenes.title: Be ni unutish
board: ✗ The cake was make by my mother.
✓ The cake was made by my mother.
scenes.say_native: Ikki asosiy xato bor. Birinchisi, “be” ni tushirib qoldirish: “The window broken”. Bu o‘zbekcha “oyna sindirilgan” deb o‘ylashdan kelib chiqadi, ammo inglizchada “was” shart. Ikkinchisi, participle o‘rniga oddiy shaklni qo‘yish: “was make”. To‘g‘risi “was made”. Passivdagi fe’l har doim uchinchi shaklda bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Don't forget the verb be. The window was broken. And use the past participle: the cake was made, not was make.
scenes.say_uz: Be fe’lini unutmang. Oyna sindirilgan. Va past participle ishlating: tort tayyorlangan, was make emas.

scenes.title: Tartibsiz fe’llarning V3 shakllari
board: sell – sold · find – found · grow – grown
take – taken · give – given · teach – taught
scenes.say_native: Passivda ko‘pincha tartibsiz fe’llar uchraydi, shuning uchun uchinchi shaklini yodlash kerak. Muhim juftlar: make–made, build–built, sell–sold, find–found. Yana ikkita guruh: oxiri -n bilan tugaydiganlar, ya’ni write–written, steal–stolen, take–taken, give–given, grow–grown; va teach–taught kabi o‘zgaruvchilar.
scenes.say: Many common verbs are irregular. Make, made. Build, built. Write, written. Steal, stolen. Take, taken. Give, given. Teach, taught.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p fe’llar tartibsiz. Make, made. Build, built. Write, written. Steal, stolen. Take, taken. Give, given. Teach, taught.

scenes.title: Passivga aylantiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni passivga aylantiring. Har bir gapda to‘ldiruvchini boshiga qo‘ying, “be” ni zamoniga moslab tanlang va uchinchi shakldagi fe’lni qo‘shing. Birinchi gap hozirgi zamonda, ikkinchisi o‘tgan zamonda, uchinchisi yana hozirgi zamonda. “Someone” va “they” ni aytish shart emas. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: People speak English here. Two: Someone stole my bike. Three: They sell fresh bread. Change each sentence into the passive.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Bu yerda odamlar inglizcha gapiradi. Ikkinchi: Kimdir velosipedimni o‘g‘irladi. Uchinchi: Ular yangi non sotadi. Har bir gapni passivga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “English is spoken here”. Hozirgi zamon, ko‘plik emas, shuning uchun “is”. Ikkinchi, “My bike was stolen”: o‘tgan zamon, “was”, steal–stole–stolen, uchinchi shakl “stolen”. Uchinchi, “Fresh bread is sold”: “sell–sold”, bu yerda “sold” ham o‘tgan zamon, ham uchinchi shakl. Agar “spoke” yoki “stole” deb aytgan bo‘lsangiz, uchinchi shakl kerakligini eslang.
scenes.say: One: English is spoken here. Two: My bike was stolen. Three: Fresh bread is sold.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Bu yerda inglizcha gapirishadi. Ikkinchi: Velosipedim o‘g‘irlandi. Uchinchi: Yangi non sotiladi.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol
scenes.say_native: Inkor va savolda faqat “be” bilan ishlaymiz, “do” kerak emas. Inkor: “was not built”, qisqasi “wasn’t built”. Savolda “be” ni egadan oldinga chiqaramiz: “When was the palace built?”, “Were the letters sent?”. Bu oddiy “to be” li savol bilan bir xil. “Did” ni qo‘ymang: “When did the palace built” noto‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: For questions, put be before the subject. When was the palace built? Were the letters sent? For negatives, add not. The bridge wasn't finished.
scenes.say_uz: Savolda be ni egadan oldin qo‘ying. Saroy qachon qurilgan? Xatlar yuborildimi? Inkor uchun not qo‘shing. Ko‘prik tugatilmadi.

scenes.title: Savol va inkor
board: 2) Are tickets sold online? (short answer: yes)
scenes.say_native: Endi uchta topshiriq. Birinchi: “The school was built in 2010” gapidan “qachon” deb so‘rovchi savol tuzing. Ikkinchi: “Are tickets sold online?” savoliga qisqa “ha” javobini ayting. Uchinchi: “The window was repaired” gapini inkor qiling. Har birini baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One: Ask when the school was built. Two: Answer yes, tickets are sold online. Three: Make this negative: The window was repaired.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: maktab qachon qurilganini so‘rang. Ikkinchi: ha, chiptalar onlayn sotiladi, deb javob bering. Uchinchi: Oyna ta’mirlandi gapini inkor qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “When was the school built?”. “Was” egadan oldin keldi. Ikkinchi, “Yes, they are”. Qisqa javobda faqat “be” ni takrorlaymiz, participle kerak emas, ko‘plik bo‘lgani uchun “they are”. Uchinchi, “The window wasn’t repaired”. Inkorda “was” ga “not” qo‘shildi, fe’l esa o‘zgarmadi. Agar “didn’t repaired” degan bo‘lsangiz, bu xato: passivda “did” ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: One: When was the school built? Two: Yes, they are. Three: The window wasn't repaired.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Maktab qachon qurilgan? Ikkinchi: Ha, sotiladi. Uchinchi: Oyna ta’mirlanmadi.

scenes.title: Passivni qachon ishlatamiz
board: 1) Agent unknown: My car was stolen.
3) Agent unimportant: Rice is grown in Asia.
4) Result matters more: The road is closed.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi sabab: ishni kim qilgani noma’lum, masalan “My car was stolen”. Ikkinchi: bu aniq, masalan politsiya hibsga oldi, “He was arrested”. Uchinchi: ish bajaruvchi muhim emas, “Rice is grown in Asia”. To‘rtinchi: natija muhimroq, “The road is closed”. O‘zbekchada ham shunday: “mashinam o‘g‘irlandi” deymiz, “kimdir o‘g‘irladi” demaymiz.
scenes.say: We use the passive when we don't know who did it, when it is obvious, or when it isn't important. My car was stolen. He was arrested. Rice is grown in Asia.
scenes.say_uz: Kim qilganini bilmaganda, bu aniq bo‘lganda yoki muhim bo‘lmaganda passivni ishlatamiz. Mashinam o‘g‘irlandi. U hibsga olindi. Sholi Osiyoda yetishtiriladi.

scenes.title: Jarayonlar uchun passiv
board: Then it is cleaned and ground.

examples.t: Then the cheese is cut into pieces.

scenes.say_native: Mahsulot qanday tayyorlanishini tushuntirishda passiv eng yaxshi tanlov. Chunki ishchilar emas, jarayon muhim. Odatda tartib so‘zlari bilan ishlatiladi: “first”, “then”, “next”, “after that”, “finally”. “First, the wheat is cut. Then it is cleaned and ground. Finally, the bread is baked.”
scenes.say: To describe a process, use the passive with sequence words. First, the wheat is cut. Then it is cleaned and ground. Finally, the bread is baked.
scenes.say_uz: Jarayonni tasvirlash uchun passivni tartib so‘zlari bilan ishlating. Avval bug‘doy o‘riladi. Keyin tozalanadi va un qilib maydalanadi. Oxirida non pishiriladi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: shokolad qanday tayyorlanadi
scenes.say_native: Endi kichik matnni tinglang. Unda shokolad qanday ishlab chiqarilishi tushuntiriladi. Har bir bosqichni toping: birinchi nima qilinadi, keyin nima, oxirida nima. Passiv fe’llarga e’tibor bering: “are picked”, “are dried”, “is heated”. Savollar tinglagandan keyin beriladi.
scenes.say: First, the cocoa beans are picked and left in the sun to dry. Then they are roasted and ground into a thick paste. Sugar and milk are added, and the mixture is heated. Finally, it is poured into moulds and cooled.
scenes.say_uz: Avval kakao donalari terib olinadi va quritish uchun quyoshda qoldiriladi. Keyin ular qovuriladi va quyuq massaga aylanguncha maydalanadi. Shakar va sut qo‘shiladi, aralashma isitiladi. Oxirida u qoliplarga quyiladi va sovitiladi.

scenes.title: Matn bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What happens to the beans in the sun?
2) What is added to the paste?
scenes.say_native: Matn bo‘yicha uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: kakao donalari quyoshda nima qilinadi? Ikkinchi: massaga nima qo‘shiladi? Uchinchi: oxirgi bosqich qanday? Javobni passiv bilan ayting, masalan “They are dried”. Esingizda bo‘lmasa, tezda matnni xotirangizda tiklab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: One: What happens to the beans in the sun? Two: What is added to the paste? Three: What is the last step?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Quyoshda donalarga nima bo‘ladi? Ikkinchi: Massaga nima qo‘shiladi? Uchinchi: Oxirgi bosqich qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) It is poured into moulds and cooled.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “They are dried”, donalar quritiladi. Ikkinchi, “Sugar and milk are added”, shakar va sut qo‘shiladi. E’tibor bering: ikkita ot bor, shuning uchun “are”. Uchinchi, “It is poured into moulds and cooled”: qoliplarga quyiladi va sovitiladi. Ikkita fe’l bitta “is” ga bog‘langan, ya’ni “poured and cooled”. Bu sizga o‘z matningizda gapni qisqartirishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say: One: They are dried. Two: Sugar and milk are added. Three: It is poured into moulds and cooled.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ular quritiladi. Ikkinchi: Shakar va sut qo‘shiladi. Uchinchi: U qoliplarga quyiladi va sovitiladi.

scenes.title: Passivi bo‘lmagan fe’llar
scenes.say_native: Bu juda keng tarqalgan xato. Faqat to‘ldiruvchi qabul qiladigan fe’llardan, ya’ni transitive fe’llardan passiv yasaladi. “Happen”, “arrive”, “die”, “go” kabi o‘timsiz fe’llar passivga o‘tmaydi. O‘zbekchada “sodir bo‘ldi” deymiz va bu majhul shaklga o‘xshab ketadi, shuning uchun “was happened” deyiladi. To‘g‘risi oddiy: “The accident happened”. Faqat bitta istisno bor: “be born”, “I was born in Samarkand”.
scenes.say: Some verbs have no passive. We say the accident happened, not was happened. We say I arrived, not was arrived. But we say: I was born in Samarkand.
scenes.say_uz: Ayrim fe’llarda passiv bo‘lmaydi. Hodisa sodir bo‘ldi, was happened emas. Men yetib keldim, was arrived emas. Lekin aytamiz: Men Samarqandda tug‘ilganman.

scenes.title: Agent: by bilan
board: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.

examples.t: The song was sung by a famous singer.

scenes.say_native: Agar ishni kim qilganini aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “by” va ijrochi qo‘shiladi. Bunga inglizchada “agent” deyiladi. O‘zbek tilida bu “tomonidan” so‘ziga to‘g‘ri keladi: “Shekspir tomonidan yozilgan”. “By” dan keyin ot yoki olmoshning obyekt shakli keladi: “by him”, “by us”. “By he” demang.
scenes.say: If we want to say who did the action, we use by. Hamlet was written by Shakespeare. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci. After by, use him, her or them.
scenes.say_uz: Ishni kim qilganini aytmoqchi bo‘lsak, by ishlatamiz. Hamlet Shekspir tomonidan yozilgan. Mona Liza Leonardo da Vinchi tomonidan chizilgan. By dan keyin him, her yoki them ishlating.

scenes.title: Agentni qachon tushiramiz
board: Omit by: someone, people, they, obvious
The room is cleaned (by a cleaner).

examples.t: Our flat was designed by my uncle.
The shop is closed at six.

scenes.say_native: Agentni qachon qo‘shamiz, qachon yo‘q? Agar odam yoki tashkilot qiziq va yangi ma’lumot bo‘lsa, “by” bilan qo‘shamiz: “designed by my uncle”. Agar agent “someone”, “people”, “they” bo‘lsa yoki o‘zi ma’lum bo‘lsa, tushirib qoldiramiz: “The shop is closed at six”, kim yopishi hammaga ayon.
scenes.say: Keep by when the person is interesting or new information. Our flat was designed by my uncle. Leave it out when it is obvious or unknown. The shop is closed at six.
scenes.say_uz: Odam qiziq yoki yangi ma’lumot bo‘lsa, by ni qoldiring. Kvartiramizni amakim loyihalagan. Aniq yoki noma’lum bo‘lsa, tushirib qoldiring. Do‘kon oltida yopiladi.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha by va by / with
board: ✗ My car was stolen by someone.
✗ The window was broken by a stone.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xatoni ko‘ramiz. Birinchisi, keraksiz “by someone”, “by people”, “by them” qo‘shish. “My car was stolen by someone” grammatik jihatdan noto‘g‘ri emas, ammo ortiqcha va g‘alati eshitiladi. Ikkinchisi, “by” va “with” ni aralashtirish. Ishni qilgan odam bilan “by”, ishlatilgan asbob bilan “with”: “broken by a boy with a stone”.
scenes.say: Don't add by someone. Just say: my car was stolen. And remember: by is for the person, with is for the tool. The window was broken by a boy with a stone.
scenes.say_uz: By someone qo‘shmang. Shunchaki ayting: mashinam o‘g‘irlandi. Va esda tuting: by odam uchun, with asbob uchun. Oynani bola tosh bilan sindirgan.

scenes.title: By qoldiring yoki tushiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta aktiv gapni passivga aylantiring. Agentni qoldirish kerakmi, o‘zingiz hal qiling. Birinchi: “Somebody cleaned the office”. Ikkinchi: “Picasso painted Guernica”. Uchinchi: “They closed the road”. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting, har birida avval ijrochi kerakmi-yo‘qmi, shuni hal qiling.
scenes.say: One: Somebody cleaned the office. Two: Picasso painted Guernica. Three: They closed the road. Use the passive. Do you need by?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Kimdir ofisni tozaladi. Ikkinchi: Pikasso Gernikani chizgan. Uchinchi: Ular yo‘lni yopdi. Passivni ishlating. By kerakmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “The office was cleaned”. “Somebody” ma’lum emas, shuning uchun “by” yo‘q. Ikkinchi, “Guernica was painted by Picasso”, bu yerda rassom muhim ma’lumot, shuning uchun “by Picasso” qoldiriladi. Uchinchi, “The road was closed”. “They” umumiy, ahamiyatsiz, tushiramiz.
scenes.say: One: The office was cleaned. Two: Guernica was painted by Picasso. Three: The road was closed.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ofis tozalandi. Ikkinchi: Gernika Pikasso tomonidan chizilgan. Uchinchi: Yo‘l yopildi.

scenes.title: Gazeta sarlavhalari

examples.uz: Talonchilikdan keyin bir erkak hibsga olindi

scenes.say_native: Gazeta sarlavhalari qisqa bo‘lishi kerak, shuning uchun yordamchi fe’l “be” va artikllar tushirib qoldiriladi. “Man arrested after robbery” aslida “A man has been arrested after a robbery”. Participle o‘zi passiv ma’no beradi. Kelasi zamonni bildirish uchun “to be + participle” ishlatiladi: “Museum to be reopened” degani “Muzey qayta ochiladi”.
scenes.say: Headlines are short. They leave out be and articles. Man arrested after robbery. Three rescued from river. For the future: Museum to be reopened.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhalar qisqa bo‘ladi. Ularda be va artikllar tushiriladi. Talonchilikdan keyin erkak hibsga olindi. Uch kishi daryodan qutqarildi. Kelasi zamon uchun: Muzey qayta ochiladi.

scenes.title: Sarlavhani to‘liq gapga aylantirish
board: Bridge closed → The bridge has been closed.
Two injured in crash → Two people were injured in a crash.
Airport to be expanded → The airport will be expanded.
scenes.say_native: Mana sarlavhalarni to‘liq gapga aylantirishga uchta namuna. “Bridge closed” bo‘ladi “The bridge has been closed”. “Two injured in crash” bo‘ladi “Two people were injured in a crash”. “Airport to be expanded” bo‘ladi “The airport will be expanded”. Odatda yaqinda bo‘lgan yangilik uchun “has been” yoki “was”, kelajak uchun “will be” tanlanadi.
scenes.say: Bridge closed. The bridge has been closed. Two injured in crash. Two people were injured in a crash. Airport to be expanded. The airport will be expanded.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘prik yopildi. Ko‘prik yopilgan. Halokatda ikki kishi jarohat oldi. Halokatda ikki kishi jarohat oldi. Aeroport kengaytiriladi. Aeroport kengaytiriladi.

scenes.title: Sarlavhani yoyib yozing
scenes.say_native: Uchta sarlavhani to‘liq passiv gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: “Thief caught”. Ikkinchi: “Hospital to be built”. Uchinchi: “Five hurt in fire”. Har birida “be” ni, kerakli artiklni va to‘g‘ri zamonni qo‘shing. Esingizda bo‘lsin, “catch” fe’lining uchinchi shakli “caught”. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: Thief caught. Two: Hospital to be built. Three: Five hurt in fire. Write each headline as a full passive sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: O‘g‘ri tutildi. Ikkinchi: Kasalxona quriladi. Uchinchi: Yong‘inda besh kishi jarohat oldi. Har birini to‘liq passiv gap qilib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Five people were hurt in a fire.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “A thief has been caught”. Yangilik yaqinda bo‘lgani uchun “has been” ishlatdik, “was caught” ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchi, “A hospital will be built”. “To be built” kelasi zamonni bildiradi. Uchinchi, “Five people were hurt in a fire”. “Five” ko‘plik, “people” qo‘shdik va “were” ni tanladik.
scenes.say: One: A thief has been caught. Two: A hospital will be built. Three: Five people were hurt in a fire.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: O‘g‘ri tutildi. Ikkinchi: Kasalxona quriladi. Uchinchi: Yong‘inda besh kishi jarohat oldi.

scenes.title: Yangiliklarda: is said to, is expected to
board: He is said to be rich.
The match is expected to start at 8.

examples.t: The president is expected to arrive today.
The painting is believed to be stolen.

scenes.say_native: Yangiliklarda yana bir foydali shakl bor: “is said to”, “is expected to”, “is believed to”. Ular odamlar nima deyayotganini yoki nimani kutayotganini aytadi, lekin kimligini ko‘rsatmaydi. “The president is expected to arrive today”: prezident bugun yetib kelishi kutilmoqda. O‘zbekchada “aytilishicha”, “kutilmoqda”, “deb hisoblanadi” ga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say: News reports often use these patterns. The president is expected to arrive today. The painting is believed to be stolen. He is said to be rich.
scenes.say_uz: Yangiliklarda bu qoliplar ko‘p uchraydi. Prezidentning bugun yetib kelishi kutilmoqda. Rasm o‘g‘irlangan, deb hisoblanadi. Uning boy ekani aytiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog: Registonda
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Turist Samarqandda Registonni ko‘rmoqda va gidga savol beradi. Ikkita narsani toping: madrasalar qachon qurilgan va qaysi vaqtda yopiq bo‘ladi. Savollar “was built” va “is closed” shakllarida beriladi, aynan bugungi mavzu. Dialog tugagach, savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Tourist: Excuse me, when were these madrasas built? Guide: They were built between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries. Tourist: Wow! Is the square open every day? Guide: Yes, but the gates are closed at nine in the evening.
scenes.say_uz: Turist: Kechirasiz, bu madrasalar qachon qurilgan? Gid: Ular XV va XVII asrlar orasida qurilgan. Turist: Voy! Maydon har kuni ochiqmi? Gid: Ha, lekin darvozalar kechqurun soat to‘qqizda yopiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) Is the square open every day?
scenes.say_native: Dialog haqida uchta savol. Birinchi: madrasalar qachon qurilgan? Ikkinchi: maydon har kuni ochiqmi? Uchinchi: darvozalar qachon yopiladi? To‘liq gap bilan, imkon qadar passiv shaklda javob bering. Masalan: “They were built…”. Javobingizni dialogdan eshitganingizga tayanib ayting, har bir savolga bir necha soniya oling.
scenes.say: One: When were the madrasas built? Two: Is the square open every day? Three: When are the gates closed?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Madrasalar qachon qurilgan? Ikkinchi: Maydon har kuni ochiqmi? Uchinchi: Darvozalar qachon yopiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) They were built between the 15th and 17th centuries.
3) They are closed at nine in the evening.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “They were built between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries”. Ikkinchi, “Yes, it is”. Uchinchi, “They are closed at nine in the evening”. Ko‘rdingizmi, gid “by” dan foydalanmadi, chunki quruvchilar kim bo‘lgani bu yerda muhim emas, asosiysi, qachon qurilgani. Aynan shu tabiiy suhbatdagi passivning vazifasi.
scenes.say: One: They were built between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries. Two: Yes, it is. Three: They are closed at nine in the evening.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ular XV va XVII asrlar orasida qurilgan. Ikkinchi: Ha. Uchinchi: Ular kechqurun soat to‘qqizda yopiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog: ertalabki yangilik
board: A: Did you see the news? A painting was stolen!
A: Not yet. Two men were seen near the museum.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialogda ikki do‘st nonushta paytida yangilik haqida gaplashmoqda. Muzeydan nima o‘g‘irlangani, topilganmi-yo‘qmi va kimlar ko‘ringanini tinglang. Fe’l shakllariga e’tibor bering: “was stolen”, “has been found”, “were seen”. Birinchi savol: nima o‘g‘irlangan?
scenes.say: A: Did you see the news? A painting was stolen from the city museum last night! B: Really? Has it been found? A: Not yet. Two men were seen near the building, but nobody has been arrested.
scenes.say_uz: A: Yangilikni ko‘rdingmi? Kecha kechqurun shahar muzeyidan rasm o‘g‘irlangan! B: Rostdanmi? U topildimi? A: Hali yo‘q. Bino yonida ikki erkak ko‘rilgan, lekin hech kim hibsga olinmagan.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: nima o‘g‘irlangan? Ikkinchi: u topilganmi? Uchinchi: kimdir hibsga olinganmi? Qisqa javob bering va imkon bo‘lsa, “has been” yoki “was” ni takrorlang. Ikkinchi savolda “yet” so‘zi javobda kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. Har bir savolga o‘ylab, ovoz chiqarib javob bering.
scenes.say: One: What was stolen? Two: Has it been found? Three: Has anybody been arrested?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Nima o‘g‘irlangan? Ikkinchi: U topilganmi? Uchinchi: Kimdir hibsga olinganmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) No, it hasn't been found yet.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “A painting was stolen”, rasm o‘g‘irlangan. Ikkinchi, “No, it hasn’t been found yet”: “yet” bilan hozirgi tugallangan zamon passivi, “has been found” inkori. Uchinchi, “No, nobody has been arrested”. “Nobody” o‘zi inkor ma’nosini beradi, shuning uchun “not” qo‘shmaymiz.
scenes.say: One: A painting was stolen. Two: No, it hasn't been found yet. Three: No, nobody has been arrested.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Rasm o‘g‘irlangan. Ikkinchi: Yo‘q, u hali topilmagan. Uchinchi: Yo‘q, hech kim hibsga olinmagan.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: was, were, been, -ed
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda yordamchi fe’llar zaif talaffuz qilinadi. “Was” odatda /wəz/ deb aytiladi, “were” /wə/, “been” esa ko‘pincha /bɪn/. Urg‘uni ma’noli so‘zlar oladi: “The BREAD was BAKED”. Yana bir muhim narsa: -ed oxiri uch xil o‘qiladi. Jarangsiz tovushdan keyin /t/: stopped. Jarangli tovushdan keyin /d/: cleaned. T yoki d dan keyin /ɪd/: wanted, needed.
scenes.say: The weak forms are important. The bread was baked. Stopped, with a t sound. Cleaned, with a d sound. Wanted, with an id sound.
scenes.say_uz: Zaif shakllar muhim. Non pishirilgan. Stopped, t tovushi bilan. Cleaned, d tovushi bilan. Wanted, id tovushi bilan.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib ayting
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni tabiiy tezlikda baland ovozda ayting. “Was” va “were” ni zaif, tez aytishga harakat qiling, urg‘uni esa ma’noli so‘zlarga bering. “Cleaned” da /d/, “opened” da /d/, “posted” da /ɪd/ tovushini eshitiladigan qiling. Ikki marta takrorlang. Sekin boshlang, so‘ng tezlashtiring: tabiiy ingliz nutqi aynan shunday tez eshitiladi.
scenes.say: The room was cleaned. The window was opened. The letters were posted. Say them again.
scenes.say_uz: Xona tozalandi. Oyna ochildi. Xatlar jo‘natildi. Yana takrorlang.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. “Cleaned” oxirida /d/: n jarangli tovush, shuning uchun /d/. “Opened” ham /d/. “Posted” esa t bilan tugagani uchun /ɪd/ bo‘ladi va qo‘shimcha bo‘g‘in hosil qiladi: pos-ted. Agar “posted” ni bir bo‘g‘inli qilib aytgan bo‘lsangiz, yana bir marta uni ikki bo‘g‘inda talaffuz qiling. Tabiiy ovoz uchun “was” ni qisqa qiling.
scenes.say: Cleaned ends with a d sound. Opened ends with a d sound. Posted has two syllables, with an id sound.
scenes.say_uz: Cleaned d tovushi bilan tugaydi. Opened d tovushi bilan tugaydi. Posted ikki bo‘g‘inli, id tovushi bilan.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: non qanday pishiriladi
board: How is bread made in a tandoor?
scenes.say_native: Endi mustaqil gapirish vaqti. Tandirda non qanday tayyorlanishini 5 ta passiv gap bilan tushuntiring. Boshlanishi: “First, the dough is made”. Keyin xamir yoyiladi, tandirga yopishtiriladi, pishiriladi va olinadi. Tartib so‘zlarini ishlating: first, then, next, finally.
scenes.say: Explain how bread is made in a tandoor. Use five passive sentences and sequence words: first, then, next, finally.
scenes.say_uz: Tandirda non qanday tayyorlanishini tushuntiring. Beshta passiv gap va tartib so‘zlarini ishlating: first, then, next, finally.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Then it is cut and shaped.
Next, it is put on the tandoor wall.
Finally, the bread is baked and taken out.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobni tinglang. “First, the dough is made from flour, water and salt. Then it is cut and shaped. Next, it is put on the wall of the tandoor. After a few minutes, the bread is baked. Finally, it is taken out.” Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi har gapda “be” va uchinchi shakldagi fe’l bo‘lsin. “Put” va “take–taken” tartibsiz ekanini esdan chiqarmang.
scenes.say: First, the dough is made from flour, water and salt. Then it is cut and shaped. Next, it is put on the wall of the tandoor. Finally, the bread is baked and taken out.
scenes.say_uz: Avval un, suv va tuzdan xamir qorilgan. Keyin u bo‘laklanadi va shakl beriladi. Keyin tandir devoriga yopishtiriladi. Oxirida non pishirilib, olinadi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Use it for processes, news, unknown agents
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Passiv: “be” plus uchinchi shakl. Zamonni “be” ko‘rsatadi: is made, was made, has been made, will be made. Jarayon, yangilik va noma’lum ijrochi uchun ishlatamiz. Agentni faqat muhim bo‘lsa “by” bilan qo‘shamiz. Sarlavhalarda “be” tushib qoladi. O‘timsiz fe’llar, masalan happen va arrive, passivga o‘tmaydi.
scenes.say: To sum up: the passive is be plus the past participle. Use it for processes, news and unknown agents. Add by only when the agent is important.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: passiv bu be va past participle. Uni jarayonlar, yangiliklar va noma’lum ijrochi uchun ishlating. By ni faqat ijrochi muhim bo‘lsa qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Check: be + V3 in every sentence
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: biror mahsulot qanday tayyorlanishini 8 ta passiv gap bilan yozing, masalan non, paxta matosi yoki shokolad. Har bir gapda “be” va uchinchi shakldagi fe’l bo‘lsin, kamida to‘rtta tartib so‘zi ishlating va kamida bitta “by” li gap qo‘shing. Tekshirish uchun: har gapda “is/are/was/were” bormi? Keyingi darsda nisbiy ergash gaplarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: write eight passive sentences about how a product is made. Check that every sentence has be and a past participle. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: mahsulot qanday tayyorlanishi haqida sakkizta passiv gap yozing. Har bir gapda be va past participle borligini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Biror mahsulot (non, paxta matosi, shokolad yoki o‘zingiz tanlagan) qanday tayyorlanishini 8 ta passiv gap bilan yozing va ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Mezon: har bir gapda be va uchinchi shakldagi fe’l bor, kamida 4 ta tartib so‘zi (first, then, next, finally) va kamida 1 ta by li gap ishlatilgan.

quiz.why_uz: Passiv: was + uchinchi shakl (built). Be ni tushirib bo‘lmaydi.
Hozirgi oddiy zamon passivi: is/are + V3. “Grown” uchinchi shakl.

options: The accident has been happen yesterday.
quiz.why_uz: Happen o‘timsiz fe’l, uning passivi yo‘q.
Agent bilan: was written by. Write–wrote–written.

quiz.q: My car was stolen. The agent is not mentioned because...
options: we don't know who did it
quiz.why_uz: Ijrochi noma’lum bo‘lsa, passiv ishlatiladi va by tushiriladi.
Passiv savolda be egadan oldin keladi, did kerak emas.

quiz.q: The window was broken ___ a boy ___ a stone.
What does the headline “Thief caught” mean?
quiz.why_uz: Sarlavhada be tushiriladi: thief caught = a thief has been caught.

quiz.q: The new school ___ at the moment.
quiz.why_uz: Hozir davom etayotgan ish: is being + V3.
T dan keyin -ed /ɪd/ deb o‘qiladi, qo‘shimcha bo‘g‘in hosil bo‘ladi.
